scope: Exact first-collision model bridge for arbitrary finite state/label types and every nonnegative normalized label law. Actual static hashes have independent vertex-label product PMF; chronological iid label words have the same proved product PMF on finite time indices. Actual deterministic state paths/observations are identified, and prescribed chronological word probability equals product weights only when the actual queried states are distinct, derived from actual selfavoidance. Summing the disjoint word events proves equality of static-hash survival and iid-word selfavoidance at every time for any state update. On every Z/p with p nonzero, unchanged actual least-repeat Nat.find is linked to prefix injectivity, giving exact tail probabilities and finite tail-sum expectation. Actual prime Z3/distinct nonzero increments1,2/positive uniform labels has chronological word0,1,1 of static mass0 versus iid mass1/8, and directly disproves the unrestricted word-mass identity after deleting selfavoidance. No survival/collision expectation/randomization conclusion is supplied as a premise. Classical deferred-decisions method/prior actual PMF/least-repeat proofs credited, no novelty claim. Does not prove the limiting random-increment-table collision penalty, practical fixed/keyedhash refinement, or Bernstein–Lange higher-degree asymptotic corrections. Independent native written-header check is procedural, not kernel parser/hash/execution refinement. Standard foundations/defaults; no holes/custom axioms/native proof evaluation/global flags/raised limits/waivers/new cryptographic experiment/paid compute/agent upload.
